scripts.dev: concurrently -n ml,backend,frontend -c yellow,green,cyan "cd fastapi && .\app\venv\Scripts\uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd desktop && npm run dev"
scripts.desktop:build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && cd desktop && npm run build
scripts.desktop:dist:win: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && cd desktop && npm run dist:win
